rationale: The canonical Visual Style Fabric normalizes imported style metadata, composes explicitly supplied Style DNA weights, preserves deterministic constraints/provenance, and emits provider-neutral Visual Intent IR. It must not delegate model/provider/runtime selection, candidate-set expansion, resource admission, permissions, license/distribution policy, or canonical style authority to Decision Fabric. A future consumer may separately use FA3 Decision Fabric for advisory choice among an already policy-admitted style set, but that is outside this profile's authority-neutral core contract.
